title: [DEV 3.2.0-dev-j cd9f5e4] Problem opening preferences
body:
When opening any option that accesses anything related to preferences, the application crashes and closes. I haven't had any problems until today. I attach the logs and video.

The last error is around 20:59 (see video)

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/11655834/AndroidAPS.log)

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/67511778/5c188225-4f53-4f0b-8a06-1b630c0c64bc

Thanks.

Hello,

I will try to add more information, after talking to more people who have the same thing happening to them:

AAPS works correctly, but days later this problem starts to occur.

In some cases, updating the version of AAPS, fixes the problem temporarily and days later the problem is reproduced again.

Reverting to a previous version and upgrading back to the latest version sometimes solves the problem temporarily.

Everyone I talk to has EOPatch2. I asked if it happens to anyone else using another pump on Discord and no one seems to have the problem.

All the people that I know with the problem, we are in Spain (I don't know if it has something to do with the language, although I left configured "System Default" and it kept happening.

Until the July 1 release, I think everything was fine.

If you need us to provide some more log or to do some concrete test, please, let us know.

Hello,

This morning I had a problem with the patch I put on last night and was able to draw the following conclusions:

When the patch is deactivated, the problem when opening the preferences or any option of any related section, is solved.

When the patch activation process is finished, you cannot open again any of the options related to the preferences.
